title: Acceptance tests couple domain questions to tool names, arg maps and exact output strings
evidence: questions_test.go:20-22,81-83 — each sampleQuestions row pins a natural-language question to a specific tool name, argument map, and exact rendered substrings (e.g. 'Head-to-head in selection: Flamengo 18 wins, Fluminense 14 wins, 12 draws'); _atdd_review.md Priority 1/2 (score 0.5714) flags no DSL layer, so renaming a tool/param or reformatting output turns the spec red though behaviour is unchanged
suggestion: Push tool name, argument keys and string parsing into a reusable DSL helper and assert on domain facts, not rendered strings

title: tools.go is 1685 lines in a single file
evidence: tools.go (1685 lines; wc -l) holds all 16 tool handlers; maintainability=0.4347 from scores.json
suggestion: Split tool handlers by category (match/team/player/competition/stats) into separate files

title: Player-by-club queries for Brazilian clubs return 0 results (FIFA 19 data limitation)
evidence: questions_test.go:58-63 — search_players club=Flamengo and club='São Paulo FC' both assert '0 players found' because the bundled fifa_data.csv (FIFA 19) has no squads for those clubs; code handles it gracefully with an explanatory message rather than erroring
suggestion: None required — correct behaviour; noted so cross-run comparison knows R8's club filter is data-limited, not code-limited

title: Coverage exceeds spec: 16 tools, 34 sample questions, MCP batch + pipe transport
evidence: tools.go:112-256 registers 16 tools; questions_test.go:13-128 defines 34 sample questions (spec minimum is 20, enforced at questions_test.go:132); mcp_test.go:140-200 exercises JSON-RPC batch and real-pipe transport
suggestion: No action — surfaced as enhancement beyond spec
